name: Four Days Christian Tour of Egypt From Taba Port
description: Enjoy your Holy Land Tours in Egypt by extend tours to Cairo and St, Catherine from Taba and visit the amazing Sant Catherine Monastery with Moses mountain and know more about the Egyptian history during your Cairo Tours to Giza Pyramids and Egyptian Museum with special visit to Coptic Cairo
overview: Enjoy your Holy Land Tours in Egypt by extend tours to Cairo and St, Catherine from Taba and visit the amazing Sant Catherine Monastery with Moses mountain and know more about the Egyptian history during your Cairo Tours to Giza Pyramids and Egyptian Museum with special visit to Coptic Cairo

itinerary.title: Arrive Taba
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt Tours representative will meet and assist you at Taba Border, Transfer to St. Catherine by private air-conditioned vehicle, have dinner. Overnight in St. Catherine

itinerary.title: Moses Mountain - St. Catherine - Cairo
itinerary.description: Wake up call at 01:30 am., A cup of tea will be offered to each person for free, around 02:00 am, it is your chance to escape the crowds, try different adventure while climbing Moses mountain, enjoy the sun rising over Sinai Mountains, then come down for a magical visit to St. Catherine Monastery, passing by Room of the Skulls, the last point will be to the famous burning bush, at the end of your tour drive back to Cairo, arrive Cairo Hotel, Check into hotel and overnight Optional Tour; and have dinner Cruise show in Cairo River Nile.

itinerary.title: Pyramids – Museum – Coptic Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and The Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at an oriental restaurant in Cairo , continue your Cairo and Nile Cruise Package by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Departure Cairo
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet & assist at Taba Border Cairo International Airport + transfer to hotel by air-conditioned vehicle
01 Night accommodation in St, Catherine including breakfast & dinner
02 Nights accommodation in Cairo including breakfast & all taxes
01 day tour in Cairo as mentioned in program including Entrance fees & English speaking guide
Transfer Taba / St, Catherine / Cairo by air-conditioned vehicle
Entrance fees to all sites as mentioned in program
Assist & transfer to Cairo International airport on final departure.
exclusions: Supplement cost for the Grand Egyptian Museum instead of the Old Egyptian Museum: USD 25 per person
Entrance inside any of the pyramids will be with extra fees (Tickets can be booked on the Spot) -1st Great Pyramids: 35.00 USD$ - 2nd Pyramids OR 3rd Pyramid: 15.00 USD$
Entrance fees inside any of the pyramids or inside the mummy room at the Egyptian Museum.
Any other optional tours if required.
